text:
marco: Quick thread: final sweep on release notes + changelog for docs v0.13.1. Goal: merge migration guide, SDK snippet parity, fix a handful of anchors, and add a concise known-issues block. Who can own publish? ping @maya

maya: I can own publish and the release blurb. Freeze PRs by tomorrow 10am PT. Please drop PR links and call out any copy/snippet issues. :white_check_mark:

sue: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5733 -- migration guide for embed-streaming removal. Includes a short diff showing old -> new snippet changes. Needs a quick copy edit for tone.

ben: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5741 -- JS/Py snippet parity pass. Replaced `client.generate()` with `client.text.generate()` in Python and `await rdw.text.generate(...)` in JS. Left `// MIGRATE` tags inline. Ran smoke tests locally.

marco: Found two pages with stale anchors to the caching doc. Replace `#/kv_cache` with `/docs/perf/caching#kv-cache` and add redirects. I pushed a tiny redirect update in a separate PR.

maya: Draft for behavioral-change line (put under "Behavioral changes"): "Routing fallback now prefers latency-compatible model variants; this can affect per-request sampling and tail-latency characteristics." Keep it terse.

sue: Also add a short example comparing routing policies, e.g.:
```yaml
route_policy:
  policy: latency
# vs
  policy: cost
```
marco: Good. One more: remove numeric token counts and ms numbers from examples. Replace with placeholder text like `<sample output>` or keep output mocked. Users misread those into guarantees.

ben: I updated snippets to use mocked outputs and added `// MIGRATION` comments where relevant. Smoke tests: \u2705 JS + Py pass locally.

ops-bot: FYI: we've seen Netlify SSG anchor TTL cause short-lived stale anchors. If post-merge 404s appear, ops can run a targeted cache invalidate. Ping `@ops` with the merged PR link.

maya: Known-issues bullets draft (short): - Sidebar anchor cache may show stale anchors briefly after deploy; ops can invalidate cache on request. - embed-streaming removed: migrate to embeddings.v2 or contact SE for Dedicated migration help. - Python SDK: `client.generate` aliases are deprecated; prefer `client.text.generate`. Keep each bullet one line.

marco: docs-bot checklist: 1) All PR links posted 2) Snippets smoke-tested 3) Changelog entry added to /changelogs/0.13.1.md 4) Known-issues included 5) Owner runs `/docs release-ready` to queue publish.

maya: I will assemble the changelog blurb and open a PR for /changelogs/0.13.1.md by this afternoon. If you merge after freeze, add a one-line blurb to the PR describing the change so I can fold it into the release notes.

ben: \u2705 snippet tested (JS + Py) -- smoke tests green.

sue: Copy I will scrub: remove ms/token numbers, standardize model spec to `kestrel/v1` where applicable, fix backtick mismatches in code fences.

maya: Thanks. Final publish window tentatively tomorrow at 11:30 PT. I will run the `/docs release-ready` step once changelog PR is merged and checks are green. If anything blocks, flag here and paste the PR link. :rocket:
